html:
In the metaverse, whether in augmented or virtual reality, it is not enough for what we see to look real; what we hear must also sound realistic and immersive. This video from Meta AI shows research toward that goal.

As Fanyu Meng sums it up, Meta AI’s models can create sound with a convincing sense of space out of thin air, and can even take sound recorded in the real world and give it the acoustics of a virtual space instead.

Video: Meta AI, shared by Fanyu Meng on Ziyu Acoustics.
